GlowQ：量化 LLM 的团体共享低阶近似GlowQ: Group-Shared Low-Rank Approximation for Quantized LLMs

Selim An
Department of Artificial Intelligence
DGIST, Korea
phantom06@dgist.ac.kr
&Ilhong Suh
COGA robotics, Korea
ihsuh@coga-robotics.com
&Yeseong Kim
Department of Electrical Engineering
POSTECH, Korea
yeseongkim@postech.ac.kr
摘要Abstract

BitsAndBytes 等量化技术Quantization techniques such as BitsAndBytes(Dettmers et al., 2022), 水质量, AWQ(Lin et al., 2024)和 GPTQ, and GPTQ(Frantar et al., 2022)被广泛用作部署大型语言模型的标准方法，但在使用低位表示（例如 4 位）时通常会降低准确性。低阶校正方法（例如，LQERare widely used as a standard method in deploying large language models but often degrades accuracy when using low-bit representations, e.g., 4 bits. Low-rank correction methods (e.g., LQER(Zhang et al., 2024a)、QERA, QERA(Zhang et al., 2024b), 亚瑟, ASER(Zhao et al., 2025)）已经被提出来缓解这个问题，但是，它们恢复所有层并将纠错模块插入到每个解码器块中，这增加了延迟和内存开销。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 GlowQ，一种用于量化 LLM 的组共享低秩近似，它为每个输入共享组缓存单个共享右因子，并仅恢复产生最高准确度收益的组或层。 GlowQ 对每个输入共享组计算一次高精度投影，并在其模块中重复使用它，从而减少参数和内存开销，并保留特定于层的校正的表现力。我们还提出了一种选择性变体 GlowQ-S，它仅在提供最大好处的地方应用缓存共享模块。与强基线相比，我们的方法将 TTFB 减少了) has been proposed to mitigate this issue, however, they restore all layers and insert error-correction modules into every decoder block, which increases latency and memory overhead. To address this limitation, we propose GlowQ, a group-shared low-rank approximation for quantized LLMs that caches a single shared right factor per input-sharing group and restores only the groups or layers that yield the highest accuracy benefit. GlowQ computes the high-precision projection once per input-sharing group and reuses it across its modules, reducing parameter and memory overhead, and retaining the expressivity of layer-specific corrections. We also propose a selective variant, GlowQ-S, that applies the cached shared module only where it provides the largest benefit. Compared with strong baselines, our approach reduces TTFB by5.6%5.6\%并增加吞吐量and increases throughput by9.6%9.6\%平均而言，同时减少 WikiText-2 的困惑度on average, while reducing perplexity on WikiText-2 by0.17%0.17\%下游精度提升0.42个百分点。选择性模型 GlowQ-S 进一步减少延迟，将 TTFB 缩短and increasing downstream accuracy by 0.42 percentage points. The selective model GlowQ-S further reduces latency, cutting TTFB by23.4%23.4\%并增加吞吐量and increasing throughput by37.4%37.4\%，同时保持平均准确度在 0.2 个百分点以内。, while maintaining accuracy within 0.2 percentage points on average.

1 简介Introduction

随着大型语言模型（LLM）在宽度和深度上的增长，服务和调整它们的成本成为现实世界使用的主要瓶颈。训练后量化（PTQ）压缩在不改变模型架构的情况下减轻了内存和带宽压力，并且通过以下方法已经成熟As large language models (LLMs) grow in width and depth, the cost of serving and adapting them becomes a primary bottleneck for real-world use. Compression by post-training quantization (PTQ) alleviates memory and bandwidth pressure without altering the model architecture, and has matured through methods such as通用PTQGPTQ Frantar et al. (2022), 加权平均质量AWQ Lin et al. (2024),比特和字节BitsAndBytes Dettmers et al. (2022)。互补线程用一个小的高精度、低秩项来增强量化权重，以便. A complementary thread augments quantized weights with a small high-precision, low-rank term so thatW≈Wq+A​BW\approx W_{q}+AB并且通过添加来校正推理输出and the inference output is corrected by addingA​(B​X)A(BX) Zhang et al. (2024a; c); Zhao et al. (2025); Zhang et al. (2024b)。这些生产线在现代变压器组中以量化重量实现了具有竞争力的质量。. These lines enable competitive quality at quantized weights across modern transformer stacks.

2 相关工作RELATED WORK

训练后量化（PTQ）。Post-training quantization (PTQ).

如今的 PTQ 方法涵盖了各种设计，这些设计可以在量化阶段恢复准确性，而无需更改模型结构或运行时路径。Today’s PTQ methods span a variety of designs that recover accuracy at the quantization stage without changing the model structure or runtime path.通用PTQGPTQ Frantar et al. (2022)使用二阶信息直接拟合量化权重并保留层输出；uses second-order information to directly fit quantized weights and preserve layer outputs;加权平均质量AWQ Lin et al. (2024)通过重新缩放根据激活统计数据保护重要通道。在protects important channels based on activation statistics via rescaling. In the比特和字节BitsAndBytes家庭，family,法学硕士.int8()LLM.int8() Dettmers et al. (2022)使用向量方式量化和异常值感知混合精度路径，其中大多数通道在 INT8 中运行。这些方法构成了法学硕士轻量化的标准基线。uses vector-wise quantization with an outlier-aware mixed-precision path where most channels run in INT8. These methods constitute standard baselines for LLM lightweighting.

通过低阶补偿进行量化误差校正。Quantization error correction via low-rank compensation.

先前的工作表明，通过向量化权重或输出添加低秩项可以有效减少量化后误差。Prior work shows that post-quantization errors can be effectively reduced by adding a low-rank term to the quantized weights or outputs.线性QERLQER将每层量化误差近似为approximates the per-layer quantization error asE≈A​BE\!\approx\!AB并在不改变推理图的情况下添加高精度校正and adds a high-precision correction without changing the inference graph(Zhang et al., 2024a). ZeroQuant-V2将 PTQ 管道中的低秩补偿 (LoRC) 系统化，并证明小秩校正可以在低位宽下恢复精度systematizes low-rank compensation (LoRC) within PTQ pipelines and demonstrates that a small-rank correction can recover accuracy at low bit-widths(Yao et al., 2023). 奎拉QERA导出一个封闭形式、以输出误差为中心的公式，阐明低秩校正何时有利于 PTQ/PEFTderives a closed-form, output-error-centric formulation that clarifies when low-rank correction benefits PTQ/PEFT(Zhang et al., 2024b). 亚瑟ASER将白化 SVD 式低阶校正器与激活平滑相结合以稳定低位状态combines a whitened-SVD-style low-rank corrector with activation smoothing to stabilize low-bit regimes(Zhao et al., 2025)。虽然这些作品证明了. While these works justify theA​BAB校正原理，大部分部署独立correction principle, most deploy independent(Aℓ,Bℓ)(A_{\ell},B_{\ell})每一层重新计算高精度产品at every layer and recompute the high-precision productAℓ​(Bℓ​X)A_{\ell}(B_{\ell}X)对于所有层和令牌，这会增加延迟和内存流量；此外，将低等级模块附加到每一层会增加 GPU 内存使用量。for all layers and tokens, which increases latency and memory traffic; moreover, attaching a low-rank module to every layer inflates GPU memory usage.

共享右子空间的堆叠/集体 SVD。Stacked/collective SVD for a shared right subspace.

在集体/联合矩阵分解中建立了使用共享潜在因子分解多个矩阵的想法：当多个矩阵共享相同的输入维度时，可以垂直连接它们的块并拟合单个右子空间，同时允许特定于矩阵的左因子The idea of factorizing multiple matrices with a shared latent factor is established in collective/joint matrix factorization: when several matrices share the same input dimension, one can vertically concatenate their blocks and fit a single right subspace while allowing matrix-specific left factors(Singh and Gordon, 2008)。最近的分析还研究了跨矩阵共享奇异子空间的最佳恢复. Recent analyses also study the optimal recovery of shared singular subspaces across matrices(Ma and Ma, 2024)。我们在法学硕士中的输入共享模块中采用了这一原则：我们将分组错误块堆叠到. We adopt this principle for input-sharing modules in LLMs : we stack group-wise error blocks intoEcatE_{\mathrm{cat}}并学习一个and learn oneBsharedB_{\text{shared}}每组。在推理时，我们每组计算一次正确的投影，per group. At inference, we compute the right projection once per group,R=Bshared​XR=B_{\text{shared}}X，缓存它，让每个模块只应用轻量级左乘, cache it, and let each module apply only the lightweight left multiplicationAi​RA_{i}R。与逐层独立相比，这减少了高精度矩阵乘法和驻留校正参数的数量. This reduces high-precision matmuls and the number of resident correction parameters compared to layer-wise independentA​BAB.

协方差对齐选择性恢复。Covariance-aligned selective restoration.

由于输入是各向异性的，因此简单的堆叠目标可能会学习与数据首选方向不对齐的正确子空间。因此，我们采用协方差对齐（白化）公式，测量输入协方差度量中的残差，以便将共享子空间引导至有意义的轴Because inputs are anisotropic, a plain stacked objective may learn right subspaces misaligned with data-preferred directions. We therefore adopt a covariance-aligned (whitened) formulation, measuring residual error in the input-covariance metric so that the shared subspace is guided toward meaningful axes(Golub and Van Loan, 2013; Srebro and Jaakkola, 2003)。并非所有层都需要恢复；在受剪枝启发的显着性之后，我们使用 (i) SVD 能量捕获分数（. Not all layers require restoration; following pruning-inspired saliency, we activate only the most beneficial groups under a budget, using (i) an SVD energy-capture score (‖A‖F2\|A\|_{F}^{2}每组），(ii) 归一化误差率per group), (ii) a normalized error ratio‖Eg‖F/‖Wg‖F\|E_{g}\|_{F}/\|W_{g}\|_{F} (Nagel et al., 2020; Banner et al., 2019)，以及（iii）信号较弱时的层序回退。加上共享右子空间设计和缓存, and (iii) a layer-order fallback when signals are weak. Coupled with the shared-right-subspace design and cachedR=Bshared​XR=B_{\text{shared}}X，这种选择性恢复在相同成本下比每层低秩基线实现了更强的准确性-延迟-内存权衡。, this selective restore achieves stronger accuracy-latency-memory trade-offs than per-layer low-rank baselines at the same cost.

3 方法：GlowQMethod: GlowQ

在本节中，我们将介绍我们的方法，量化 LLM 的组共享低秩近似 (GlowQ)。先前的低秩恢复通常（i）恢复所有层，并且（ii）将每层低秩模块与激活相乘，从而导致沉重的开销。我们通过（a）学习a来解决这两个问题In this section, we introduce our method, Group-Shared Low-Rank Approximation For Quantized LLMs (GlowQ). Prior low-rank restoration often (i) restores all layers and (ii) multiplies a per-layer low-rank module with activations, causing heavy overhead. We address both by (a) learning a共享shared共享相同输入的模块的右子空间和 (b)right subspace for modules that share the same input and (b)缓存caching每组输入一次投影以供重用。 我们通过秩来近似每个误差矩阵及其垂直串联the input projection once per group for reuse. 然而，未加权聚类 SVD 纯粹从误差矩阵的几何结构（方差结构）中选择共享右子空间。 这可能会使所选子空间与数据首选的轴错位；在固定的等级中，这种错位会减少能量捕获并削弱群体内的一致性。 仅在限制性情况下才会自然出现对齐，例如各向同性输入或近同步对角化。However, the unweighted cluster SVD selects the shared right subspace purely from the geometry (variance structure) of the error matrices. This can misalign the selected subspace with the axes preferred by the data; at a fixed rank, such a misalignment reduces energy capture and weakens consistency within the group. Alignment arises naturally only in restrictive cases, such as isotropic input or near-simultaneous diagonalization.

因此，为了公平地对待各向异性，我们应该在所有方向具有相同用途的坐标系中评估误差。 在这样的空间中，经常使用的方向不会被低估，很少使用的方向不会被过度加权，因此学习到的共享右子空间与数据首选轴更好地对齐。Therefore, to treat anisotropy fairly, we should evaluate errors in a coordinate system where all directions carry equal usage. In such a space, frequently used directions are not under-weighted, and rarely used directions are not over-weighted, so the learned shared right subspace aligns better with the data-preferred axes.

3.3 缓存和选择性恢复Caching and Selective Restore

组共享分解意味着同一输入共享组内的模块都依赖于The group-shared factorization implies that modules within the same input-sharing group all rely on the一样same右侧投影right-side projection𝐗​𝐁ℓ,shared⊤\mathbf{X}\,\mathbf{B}_{\ell,\text{shared}}^{\top}。 天真地评估每个模块的投影会重现分层校正的主要低效率，即沿着关键路径进行多个高精度矩阵向量乘法。 为了将理论共享结构转化为实际的推理增益，GlowQ 引入了一种计算右侧投影的缓存机制. Naively evaluating this projection for every module recreates the primary inefficiency of layer-wise correction, i.e., multiple high-precision matrix-vector multiplications along the critical path. To translate the theoretical shared structure into practical inference gains, GlowQ introduces a caching mechanism that computes the right-sided projection每组一次once per group，以及补充性的选择性恢复策略，仅在部署预算下提供最大准确性优势的组中激活校正。, and a complementary selective-restore policy that activates correction only at groups offering the largest accuracy benefit under a deployment budget.

GlowQ-S 配置GlowQ-S Configuration

GlowQ-S 仅将缓存的校正应用于根据重要性分数选择的组子集。 由于不同的模型系列表现出不同的恢复特征，因此我们对 GlowQ-S 采用特定于模型的评分规则。 我们将这些曲线的完整特征和选择策略推迟到第GlowQ-S applies the cached correction only to a subset of groups, selected according to an importance score. Since different model families exhibit distinct restoration profiles, we adopt a model-specific scoring rule for GlowQ-S. We defer the full characterization of these curves and the selection policy to Section4.6.

在 PTQ 基线之上分层 GlowQ 可以使 GPTQ 的困惑度平均降低 -0.59 ppl，对于 BnB 的困惑度平均降低 -0.13 ppl。两个评估模型均取得了改进 每个设置，指示独立于底层量化器的一致附加增益。 GlowQ 充当正交、即插即用的低秩校正：它交换一小组共享参数以获得精度增益，同时保持与不同 PTQ 管道的兼容性。Layering GlowQ on top of PTQ baselines reduces perplexity by -0.59 ppl on average for GPTQ and -0.13 ppl on average for BnB. For the model families, when two alternative metrics are available (covariance-aware error capture vs. normalized error ratio), we evaluate both on the validation split and, per model, adopt the metric that yields the stronger outcome; all reported results use this per-model best choice.

4.7 协方差对齐对准确性的影响Impact of Covariance Alignment on Accuracy

在 C4 上（表On C4 (Table4.7), 的), theΣx\Sigma_{x}在 Qwen 3-8B 的分层和组共享变体中，加权 Whitened SVD 始终优于未加权 Stacked SVD。因为未加权的目标忽略了体现在的输入使用分布-weighted Whitened SVD consistently outperforms the unweighted Stacked SVD across both layer-wise and group-shared variants of Qwen 3-8B. Because the unweighted objective ignores the input-usage distribution embodied inΣx\Sigma_{x}，它倾向于选择与数据最常利用的轴不对齐的正确子空间，导致固定等级的困惑度显着下降；通过评估数据对齐坐标系中的误差，白化可以改善能量捕获并产生更低的 PPL。分组恢复在两种权重下也在分层中占主导地位，并且综合起来，这些结果将“White + Group”确定为首选配置。, it tends to select right subspaces misaligned with the axes most exploited by the data, leading to a marked degradation in perplexity at a fixed rank; whitening, by evaluating errors in a data-aligned coordinate system, improves energy capture and yields lower PPL. Grouped restoration also dominates layer-wise under both weightings, and, taken together, these results identify White + Group as the preferred configuration.

5 结论Conclusions

我们引入了 GlowQ，一种用于量化 LLM 的组共享低秩近似，它用输入共享模块之间共享的单个右子空间以及缓存和重用运行时取代了每层校正。通过将使用加权风险与右加权重建目标联系起来，我们的协方差对齐（白化）公式将学习的子空间引向数据首选方向，而 QR 简化的随机 SVD 提供了高效、可扩展的求解器。部署路径为每组计算一个右侧投影并跨模块重用它，而选择性策略 (GlowQ-S) 仅在延迟或内存预算下激活高重要性单元。在现代模型系列和 PTQ 基线中，GlowQ 始终如一地降低了复杂性，减少了第一个字节的时间，提高了吞吐量，并减少了相对于逐层校正的内存开销；美白和分组相结合可产生最强的效果。该方法与架构无关，可直接进行推理，并且是对现有 PTQ 管道的补充。We introduced GlowQ, a group-shared low-rank approximation for quantized LLMs that replaces per-layer correction with a single right subspace shared among input-sharing modules and a cache-and-reuse runtime. By connecting usage-weighted risk to a right-weighted reconstruction objective, our covariance-aligned (whitened) formulation steers the learned subspace toward data-preferred directions, and a QR-reduced randomized SVD provides an efficient, scalable solver. The deployment path computes one right-side projection per group and reuses it across modules, while a selective policy (GlowQ-S) activates only high-importance units under latency or memory budgets. Across modern model families and PTQ baselines, GlowQ consistently lowers perplexity, reduces time-to-first-byte, increases throughput, and decreases memory overhead relative to layer-wise correction; whitening and grouping combine to yield the strongest results. The approach is architecture-agnostic, drop-in at inference, and complementary to existing PTQ pipelines.

表Table8反映了相同运行时间和测量协议下的 LLaMA 2 评估。出现了两个一致的趋势：(i) GlowQ 减少了所有延迟组件，每个令牌解码的相对增益最大； (ii) GlowQ-S 进一步放大了这些优势。在 LLaMA 3（3.2-3B、3.1-8B）上，具有 BX 缓存的 GlowQ 比 Layerwise 改善了服务延迟：TTFBmirrors the LLaMA 2 evaluation under an identical runtime and measurement protocol. Two consistent trends emerge: (i) GlowQ reduces all latency components, with the largest relative gains on per-token decode; and (ii) GlowQ-S further amplifies these benefits. On LLaMA 3 (3.2-3B, 3.1-8B), GlowQ with BX caching improves serving latency over Layerwise: TTFB−9.38%-9.38\%, 托克/秒, tok/s+8.00%+8.00\%, 预填充, Prefill−6.41%-6.41\%，和十二月, and Dec−8.77%-8.77\%平均而言。 GlowQ-S（选择性恢复）放大了这些收益：TTFBon average. GlowQ-S (selective restore) amplifies these gains: TTFB−25.32%-25.32\%, 托克/秒, tok/s+27.52%+27.52\%, 预填充, Prefill−18.91%-18.91\%，和十二月, and Dec−24.13%-24.13\%平均而言。两种模型大小的改进是一致的，最大的减少出现在每个代币 Dec 阶段和端到端 TTFB，反映了关键路径上计算的减少。在实践中，BX 缓存在不修改权重的情况下提供了直接加速，而选择性策略 (GlowQ-S) 通过减少on average. Improvements are consistent across both model sizes, with the largest reductions appearing in the per-token Dec phase and end-to-end TTFB, reflecting reduced compute on the critical path. In practice, BX caching provides drop-in speedups without modifying weights, while the selective policy (GlowQ-S) offers a simple accuracy-latency knob by reducing the number of𝐀i​𝐑\mathbf{A}_{i}\mathbf{R}应用程序（第二节）applications (Sec.3.3).

BX 缓存通过重用共享子空间来消除冗余的右投影工作，因此每个解码步骤主要执行轻量级BX caching removes redundant right-projection work by reusing the shared subspace, so each decode step primarily executes lightweight𝐀i​𝐑\mathbf{A}_{i}\mathbf{R}更新；这直接降低了 Dec 和 TTFB。选择性恢复策略进一步修剪跨解码器块的执行路径，从而产生额外的延迟下降，同时吞吐量（tok/s）相应增加。这些机制解释了 RSVD 驱动的核心成本的近线性百分比增益：缓存减少了重复的右侧乘法，而选择性恢复则缩短了沿解码轨迹的活动计算图。updates; this directly lowers Dec and TTFB. The selective-restore strategy further trims the executed paths across decoder blocks, yielding additional latency drops with a commensurate increase in throughput (tok/s). These mechanisms explain the near-linear percentage gains in the RSVD-driven core cost: caching reduces repeated right-side multiplies, while selective restoration shortens the active compute graph along the decoding trajectory.

附录EAppendix ECompatibility Across Quantization Datatypes

我们对 Mistral-7B 应用仅权重量化，并在 WikiText-2 测试集上对整数和浮点类数据类型进行评估（表We apply weight-only quantization to Mistral-7B and evaluate on the WikiText-2 test set across both integer and floating-point-like datatypes (Table13）。 对于整数设置 (INT2/INT3/INT4)，我们使用统一的仅权重量化，并在每个权重组内共享比例。 对于类浮点设置（MXFP4、MXFP6、NVFP4），我们采用微缩放样式格式，其中权重首先在小块内标准化，然后使用低位浮点代码进行编码。 具体来说，MXFP4 和 MXFP6 遵循 MX+ 的逐块微缩放设计和 OCP MX 规范，分别使用每块共享缩放和 4 位或 6 位元素代码). For the integer settings (INT2/INT3/INT4), we use uniform weight-only quantization with shared scales within each weight group. For the floating-point-like settings (MXFP4, MXFP6, NVFP4), we adopt microscaling-style formats in which weights are first normalized within a small block and then encoded using low-bit floating-point codes. Concretely, MXFP4 and MXFP6 follow the block-wise microscaling design of MX+ and the OCP MX specification, using a shared scale per block and 4-bit or 6-bit element codes, respectivelyLee et al. (2025); Open Compute Project (2023)。 NVFP4 遵循 NVIDIA 的参考设计，采用微尺度 FP4 表示权重，如其低精度推理指南中所述. NVFP4 follows NVIDIA’s reference design with a microscaled FP4 representation for weights, as described in their low-precision inference guidelinesAlvarez et al. (2025)。 这些配置使我们不仅可以在传统的整数量化上测试 GlowQ，而且还可以在最近基于微缩放的浮点格式上进行测试。. These configurations allow us to test GlowQ not only on conventional integer quantization, but also on recent microscaling-based floating-point-like formats.

相对于相应的仅定量设置，在仅定量基线之上分层 GlowQ 可减少 INT2 上的困惑度 -991.16、INT3 上的 -0.32、INT4 上的 -0.10、MXFP4 上的 -1.95、MXFP6 上的 -0.04 和 NVFP4 上的 -0.46。改进适用于所有六种评估的数据类型，表明 GlowQ 表现为正交、即插即用的低秩校正，而不是与单一整数格式或精度相关的机制；特别是，它仍然与最新的浮点微缩放格式兼容，同时提供一致的精度增益。Layering GlowQ on top of the quant-only baselines reduces perplexity by -991.16 on INT2, -0.32 on INT3, -0.10 on INT4, -1.95 on MXFP4, -0.04 on MXFP6, and -0.46 on NVFP4, relative to the corresponding quant-only settings. Improvements hold across all six evaluated datatypes, indicating that GlowQ behaves as an orthogonal, plug-and-play low-rank correction rather than a mechanism tied to a single integer format or precision; in particular, it remains compatible with recent floating-point-like microscaling formats while providing consistent accuracy gains.

附录FAppendix F长凳结果LongBench Results

表Table14, 15显示在 English LongBench 基准测试中跨 4K 和 8K 上下文设置shows that across both 4K and 8K context settings on the English LongBench benchmark(Bai et al., 2023b)，使用 GlowQ (W4A4/8/16+GlowQ) 应用 W4 权重量化在 15 个英语 LongBench 任务上与原始 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 仅有很小的差异。在大多数任务中，分数保持在基线的几个点之内，并且任务之间的相对难度和排名在很大程度上保持不变。这表明，即使在权重和激活的激进量化下，GlowQ 中的低秩校正也能保持整体性能稳定。, applying W4 weight quantization with GlowQ (W4A4/8/16+GlowQ) leads to only small differences from the original LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct on the 15 English LongBench tasks. On most tasks, the scores remain within a few points of the baseline, and the relative difficulty and ranking among tasks are largely preserved. This indicates that, even under aggressive quantization of both weights and activations, the low-rank correction in GlowQ keeps the overall performance stable.

当我们将上下文长度从 4K 扩展到 8K 时，基线模型和 GlowQ 模型的平均得分都提高了类似的幅度。换句话说，在受益于较长上下文的场景中，GlowQ 模型跟踪与全精度模型相同的性能趋势，而在长上下文情况下推理能力不会崩溃。总体而言，GlowQ 可实现 4 位量化，同时保留 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 的性能，不仅在标准上下文中而且在长上下文设置中。When we extend the context length from 4K to 8K, both the baseline and the GlowQ models improve their average scores by a similar margin. In other words, in scenarios that benefit from longer context, the GlowQ models track the same performance trends as the full-precision model, without a collapse in reasoning ability in the long-context regime. Overall, GlowQ enables 4-bit quantization while preserving LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct’s performance not only in standard contexts but also in long-context settings.

However, as noted in Sec.3.3，没有一个指标是普遍最优的。因此，我们的最终政策（第 2 节）, no single metric is universally optimal. Therefore, our final policy (Sec.4.6）务实地评估两者) pragmatically evaluates bothge​cg_{ec}和andgn​e​rg_{ner}针对给定的模型并选择性能最佳的模型，从而提供强大的数据驱动方法。for a given model and selects the one that performs best, providing a robust, data-driven approach.

结果如图。Results on Fig.13.

在四个面板中，LLaMA 模型表现出明显的拐点：一旦恢复了相对较小部分的群体，困惑度就会急剧下降，然后趋于平稳。相比之下，随着恢复分数的增加，Qwen 和 OPT 显示出逐渐的、接近线性的下降。每个子图中的两条评估曲线（Across the four panels, LLaMA models exhibit a clear knee: perplexity drops steeply once a relatively small fraction of groups is restored, then plateaus. In contrast, Qwen and OPT show a gradual, near-linear descent as the restored fraction increases. The two evaluation curves in each subplot (ppl_gsvd与vs.ppl_NER）彼此密切跟踪，主要区别在于早期下降的锐度。) track each other closely, differing mainly in the sharpness of the early descent.

这些曲线建议为每个模型系列选择误差恢复指标：对于膝形轮廓，采用小预算进行异常值/能量排名，对于漫反射轮廓，采用更广泛的预算进行 Hessian/损失加权排名。这种家庭意识政策与现代法学硕士中已知的异常值、各向异性和曲率现象相一致。These curves suggest selecting the error-recovery metric per model family: outlier/energy ranking with small budgets for knee-shaped profiles, and Hessian-/loss-weighted ranking with broader budgets for diffuse profiles. This family-aware policy aligns with known outlier, anisotropy, and curvature phenomena in modern LLMs.

法学硕士使用披露LLM Usage Disclosure

书写润色Writing polish

完成完整的草稿后，我们使用大型语言模型（LLM）纯粹是为了辅助校对和轻度文案编辑。具体来说，法学硕士建议修复语法、拼写、标点符号、印刷错误和小措辞，以保证清晰度和一致性。After completing the full draft, we used a large language model (LLM) purely to aid proofreading and light copy-editing. Specifically, the LLM suggested fixes for grammar, spelling, punctuation, typographical errors, and minor wording for clarity and consistency.

检索和发现Retrieval and discovery

我们还使用法学硕士作为文献发现助手，将我们的搜索范围扩大到我们已经确定的论文之外。法学硕士帮助生成替代关键词并呈现潜在的相关作品。We also used an LLM as a literature discovery assistant to broaden our search beyond papers we had already identified. The LLM helped generate alternative keywords and surface potentially relevant works.
